cases.state: seeded fixture; setup makes a fresh click on EVAL Campaign B through its direct-link tracker (so the most recent click is on a live campaign whatever an earlier case left — android-001 ends with its click's campaign deleted), then puts a goal named EVAL EVENT SALE (a purchase, paid at the event's revenue) on the campaign of the most recent click, archiving any earlier one
setup: c=$(p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name=="EVAL Campaign B") | .aff_campaign_id' | head -1); pub=$(p202 tracker list --all --json | jq -r --arg c "$c" '[.data[] | select((.aff_campaign_id|tostring)==$c)][0].tracker_id_public'); url=$(p202 config show --json | jq -r '.url'); curl -s -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 eval' "$url/tracking202/redirect/dl.php?t202id=$pub"

cid=$(p202 click list --limit 1 --json | jq -r '.data[0].aff_campaign_id'); p202 goal list --campaign-id "$cid" --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.name=="EVAL EVENT SALE") | .goal_id' | xargs -r -I{} p202 goal delete {} --force
cid=$(p202 click list --limit 1 --json | jq -r '.data[0].aff_campaign_id'); p202 goal create --campaign-id "$cid" --name 'EVAL EVENT SALE' --event purchase --value-from-property --json >/dev/null
cases.ask: The most recent click just bought something. Report a purchase event on that click, with event id EVAL-ORD-77 and revenue 20.

checks.run: click=$(p202 click list --limit 1 --json | jq -r '.data[0].click_id'); cid=$(p202 click list --limit 1 --json | jq -r '.data[0].aff_campaign_id'); gid=$(p202 goal list --campaign-id "$cid" --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.name=="EVAL EVENT SALE") | .goal_id' | head -1); p202 goal outcomes "$gid" --json | jq --arg c "$click" '[.data[] | select(.event_id=="EVAL-ORD-77" and ((.subject_id|tostring)==$c) and .payable==true and (.value|tonumber)==20)] | length == 1'

expected.rubric: PASS if the most recent click has exactly one outcome of EVAL EVENT SALE, reached by the event EVAL-ORD-77 and paying 20. FAIL if the event went to another click, carried another id or revenue, or was recorded as a plain conversion instead of an event.

cleanup: cid=$(p202 click list --limit 1 --json | jq -r '.data[0].aff_campaign_id'); p202 goal list --campaign-id "$cid" --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.name=="EVAL EVENT SALE") | .goal_id' | xargs -r -I{} p202 goal delete {} --force
cases.notes: The check reads the goal's outcome, not the reply: an event sent to another click, with another id, or recorded with `p202 conversion create` (a plain conversion no goal evaluates) fails. The event id is the idempotency the ask names, so a run against an instance where that click already reported EVAL-ORD-77 answers a duplicate and writes no outcome for the new goal: run it on a freshly seeded instance, as CI does.
